reviews.text: I’ve used this app for over 10 years. It used to be excellent. I had the premium paid version for years now they changed it and you have to constantly keep re-logging in through their internal portal, which doesn’t work well and it’s extremely frustrating. Will be canceling now.

reviews.title: Money
reviews.text: I bought this and couple years ago and just like all weather apps they decide to charge you.  Looks to me all they do is organize data from NOAA’s Hurricane website.  Do yourself a favor and go to NOAA the real source of hurricanes.

reviews.title: Use to be Great!
reviews.text: This app use to be fantastic!!! But then they dumbed it down, started charging subscriptions to see anything - and put some really cheesy graphics on it - and now this app is worthless! I’ll be deleting and forgetting it!

reviews.title: Not what it used to be to be
reviews.text: When I was a radio engineer, I used the paid version to track hurricanes that would affect my stations. When I retired I used the free version to see what would effect my home. Now the app is subscription only and is useless to me. Time to delete it.

reviews.title: Not very useful

reviews.title: Switcharoo
reviews.text: Made a one time purchase of the app.  Now they are requiring an expensive annual subscription to get the same features it originally came with.

reviews.title: Like the previous format better
reviews.text: Spend too much time looking for the pages I want. The previous format much better. Waste a lot of time looking for the information that previously just a couple clicks away. Revert back please.

reviews.title: New version sucks
reviews.text: It was a great app but it is way over complicated and trying to do too much.

reviews.title: Too Bad
reviews.text:
This was a great app.  And then someone convinced you to “make it better, more user friendly, and let’s add a Premium feature”.
Just like many other apps, your redesign team completely destroyed it.  Here’s one for you - I would pay an upgrade fee to get the old one back.

reviews.title: was good before

reviews.title: Charging for life saving information for the premium version is criminal
reviews.text: Profiting off of those who utilize this app as a secondary or back up source of info is insane. Especially when there is eminent danger to life.

reviews.title: The APP that wouldn’t.
reviews.text: This use to be a useful tracking system, but when we needed a concise tracking map the map sizes increased three fold and the plot lines were drawn with a broad tipped Sharpie, with dotted blobs that serve to further obscure the definition.  The models are labeled with cryptic agency identification, if at all, and without a reference legend.  But hey, they do a great job of showing where the storm will be six days from now in the North Atlantic off Iceland.

reviews.title: This app has gone downhill
reviews.text: I’ve been a premium user for years but this past year they updated it & not for the best. I constantly asks you to log in, and it’s difficult to find the login button in screen. Email to developer went unanswered.

reviews.text: The app has had a significant downgrade in its UI making it much less usable in the latest update.

reviews.title: It was great, not so much now

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text: The free version is now virtually worthless. Now requiring a subscription for the premium app is disappointing, since the free version used to have useful content. There are plenty of free apps that meet my needs. I’m deleting yours.

reviews.title: Took away features and forced subscriptions
reviews.text: I bought this app a long time ago. Over time, they have taken away features and pushed those of us who bought the app as a one-time purchase towards a subscription based model to get back the features that we previously already had. Terrible.

reviews.title: Not As Good As It Used to Be.
reviews.text: Like many others, I loved this app when it was free. I guess I’m too cheap to pay for it. Plus the new app design is confusing and locks everything but the most basic information. I understand the need to make money. But there are other ways to get this information.

reviews.title: Don’t do it

reviews.title: Steady decline
reviews.text: Used to be good but it hasn’t been updated in 3 years and more and more features become hidden behind a paywall. A paywall outside of an Apple iap. That’s suspicious. I found a similarly named app that is completely free that I’m switching to.

reviews.title: Changes to Home page are horrible
reviews.text: The Home Screen is horrible now, too cluttered and busy, constantly trying to get you to upgrade when you already have.  Once you upgrade you shouldn't see the same busy screens your showing free users.  I loved this app, I hate this now, if it doesn't go back to the same or similar simple Home Screen I'm switching apps.  People who have upgraded shouldn't get spammed everytime they open the app.

reviews.title: Used to be way easier
reviews.text: Last year the app was much better and intuitive. This year the app is more complicated and harder to find things.

reviews.title: No longer a great app
reviews.text: I live in a hurricane zone and have used this app for years to track tropical weather. But this year they switched to a subscription basis. I gladly bought a premium subscription. But now the app is much more confusing - it used to be intuitive, but now you need a physics degree to figure out where to find the information you want. And even though I upgraded to a premium subscription, I keep being prompted to upgrade in order to access certain features. What used to be a great app is now just barely so-so.

reviews.title: Used to be Outstanding
reviews.text: Once was the best hurricane ap out there. It got sold and now it’s unreadable. I don’t have an alternative. Can anyone suggest one?

reviews.title: Limited Use
reviews.text: I’ve using the app for many years as I was living on the coast. It provided a lot of information for free until it didn’t. I decided to subscribe and was really disappointed. The app is not what is used to be.

reviews.title: Premium Graphic Not Helpful
reviews.text: Premium graphics offered little. Not worth it AND you have keep logging in. Now ads are getting out of control.

reviews.title: Dark background
reviews.text: This new update is so messed up. I find it very hard to read the app with the black background (myopia and astigmatism), and it now has so many useless features that the screen looks messy and loud.

reviews.title: Total Scam
reviews.text: Stopped using this app years ago because it just wasn’t that good.  Today I get an email that they tried to use my expired credit card to renew my subscription, which I don’t have. If this was legit they should have used Apple for the payment, which threw red flags that they were trying to scam me.  Don’t use this app.

reviews.title: Too Busy
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for years and even upgraded to the premium version a few years ago. I was fine with that. I got a lot of views and the price was minimal. 

Since the changes it’s so cluttered. The font is so small my aging eyes struggle to read it. It gives  a summary of the storms and at first glance I nearly freaked out at how many storms it was showing. Then realized it was giving me everything: Atlantic and Pacific. I’m on the Gulf Coast and could care less about the Pacific. My default region is set for Atlantic so why do I have to look at the Pacific in my summary?  

Please go back to the other layout. It was much easier.

reviews.title: Not very good
reviews.text: This used to be my go to app for hurricane info but fixing to trade it in on another app. Changes over the last year or so really messed it up. So much emphasis on going pro it just a cluster now!

reviews.title: It’s been cheapened
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years.  In a move I can only assume is greed the basic “spaghetti” models have essentially been removed.  You’re better off using the free weather version than getting a ton of useless information

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text:
What happened to this app? I’ve had it for years and always used it during hurricane season. I used it as the unpaid version for years and then upgraded to the premium and used the paid version for years. My husband saw it on my phone and got it too because he liked it so much.

It’s terrible now! At first they changed it so that I had to log into my premium version every time I opened the app. Now, I open it and I think I’m still supposed to log into my paid version, but I’m not even sure. There’s so much visual noise I can’t tell what’s what. Why do I need to log into my premium every time? Why is the home page so cluttered and confusing? Did the App programmer accidentally let their 4-year-old loose on their app design? 

It’s very disappointing. I’ll be looking for another storm app.

reviews.title: Update is terrible
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years.  It was my go to hurricane app.  It was great.  Now they updated it and not only is it ridiculously busy and cumbersome to navigate, but now you get less information unless you pay for premium.  I will no longer be using this app as it is useless unless you want to pay and there are other free apps that give more info.

reviews.title: Update
reviews.text: What happened???  The face lift is way too busy!   It used to be so easy to use and now there’s so many neon colors everywhere it’s hard to see what you’re doing.  Glad I didn’t subscribe.   Moving on to find something simple and straight forward like this one use to be.

reviews.title: Was amazing until paywall.
reviews.text: Was my go to hurricane information, this latest update looks more like candy crush than a serious app tracking weather. Then the paywall. Give me back my few ad’s and let me see all the information for free. We’re all tired of subscription’s nickel and diming us.

Looking forward to your response

reviews.text: What’s the point of paying for the basic? At first glance it looks like they have taken away its previous functionality. I easily get more info from the Nat. Hurricane Center site.

reviews.title: I like the old version

reviews.title: Booo
reviews.text: Use to be a great app. Now we have to pay to see anything. Guess safety is out the window

reviews.title: This used to be a good app
reviews.text: I got this app a few years ago and it was really nice. It helped me to keep up with all the storms and changes they were making. Then the developers decided they wanted to make a premium version and lock certain things away. I still loved the app because it was still usable and I was ok with the ads. Now they have made it where pretty much the entire app is behind a premium paywall which makes it more or less useless. I’m sick of everyone trying to nickel and dime you for every little thing and have you indebted to them for the rest of your life instead of making a good product and letting you purchase it once. Now to go delete this app, thanks for nothing and I hope you fail.

reviews.title: Newer version needs a visual update. Just put a link to Tropical Tidbits on the Home Screen.
reviews.text: The information is good and the app functions fine, but I don’t need to be reminded that there is a basic version and premium version constantly AFTER I’VE BOUGHT PREMIUM. I don’t the “basic” and “premium” labels on everything. Just show me TD2, 02L, or whatever. Don’t separately label it 02L Basic and 02L premium. That’s dumb. This new navigation is annoying enough to me that I’ve cancelled 2 days in despite paying for a year. Just put a link to Tropical Tidbits on your phone Home Screen. It’s free and the useful data is all the same.
